title: Love this Convection Oven!
text: Love this Convection Oven!. Let me preface this that I am now living alone and, the majority of the time, cooking for only one person. I hate heating up an entire oven to basically make a small dish of something (with the cost of natural gas in my area, it really is cheaper to send out sometimes than to be baking on a large scale). I also really don't like using microwaves unless when I really have something fast to warm up (I hate really cooking with microwaves as foods come out rubbery and unevenly heated).When I first saw the Black and Decker convection oven, I knew it was a name I could trust (having purchased B&D appliances in the past, most recently a food processor). I absolutely love this new oven and haven't used my full size oven in well over a month now. The size (20 x 17 x 12) is large enough for baking most casseroles. The oven heats up quickly and the food cooks evenly and thoroughly. Although I have only used the broiler once since I received this, I found again the cooking to be flawless and the cleanup a lot easier than I had anticipated. The unit is a good size for my countertop (not to big, not too small) and with the black and stainless steel body, blends in well with the rest of the appliances in my kitchen. I think this unit (at under $80) is perfect for apartment dwellers, singles, small families or senior citizens (think a great Christmas gift for your aging parents). I normally don't ramble on like this with most products in review, but I really love this countertop oven and I highly recommend this appliance.

product_metadata.title: Black & Decker Convection Countertop Oven with Dual-Position Rack Slots
features: Broiling rack fits 6 slices of bread
Convection Bake, Broil, Bagel, Toast and Keep Warm functions
description: Enjoy cooking versatility—right on your countertop! Use your bagel function or simply bake, broil and reheat your favorite foods, as well as toast up to 6 slices of bread at a time. With convection cooking, meals are done to perfection as an even airflow circulates your food for faster and consistent baking every time.
